mapper.select: select dm_room_no, dm_room_emp1_no, dm_room_emp2_no, dm_room_ctime from dm_room where dm_room_emp1_no = #{dmRoomEmp1No} and dm_room_emp2_no = #{dmRoomEmp2No}
select dm_room_no, dm_room_emp1_no, dm_room_emp2_no, dm_room_ctime from dm_room where dm_room_no = #{roomNo}

select R.dm_room_no as room_no,
E.emp_no as target_emp_no, E.emp_name as target_emp_name, P.position_name as target_position_name, E.emp_presence as target_presence, EP.attach_no as target_attach_no,
LM.dm_message_content as last_message, LM.dm_message_ctime as last_message_time
from dm_room R
join ( select dm_room_no, dm_message_content, dm_message_ctime, dm_message_no,
row_number() over( partition by dm_room_no order by dm_message_no desc ) as rn
from dm_message ) LM on R.dm_room_no = LM.dm_room_no and LM.rn = 1
join emp E on E.emp_no = case when R.dm_room_emp1_no = #{empNo} then R.dm_room_emp2_no else R.dm_room_emp1_no end
join position P on E.emp_position_no = P.position_no
left outer join emp_profile EP on E.emp_no = EP.emp_no
where R.dm_room_emp1_no = #{empNo} or R.dm_room_emp2_no = #{empNo}
order by LM.dm_message_ctime desc, LM.dm_message_no desc
mapper.insert: insert into dm_message( dm_message_no, dm_room_no, dm_message_sender_no, dm_message_content ) values( #{no}, #{roomNo}, #{senderNo}, #{content} )
mapper.select:
select DM.dm_message_no as no, DM.dm_room_no as room_no, DM.dm_message_sender_no as sender_no, E.emp_name as sender_name, DM.dm_message_content as content, DM.dm_message_ctime as ctime
from dm_message DM
left outer join emp E on DM.dm_message_sender_no = E.emp_no
where DM.dm_message_no = #{messageNo}
